summary.text: Spiros Mantzavinos has represented Delaware Senate District 7 since 2020.

paragraphs.text: According to his official page, Mantzavinos was raised in Caldwell, New Jersey, and holds a bachelor's degree from Muhlenberg College and a master's degree in political science from the University of Delaware.

The page says he worked as a legislative assistant with the Delaware Senate in the 1990s, was a vice president of the New Castle County Chamber of Commerce, and founded the communications firm The Mantzavinos Group.
